title: Copper mesh in paraffin (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: A conductive copper mesh insert was embedded in paraffin phase change material inside a heated enclosure. The insert occupied part of the wax volume. The control enclosure used plain paraffin at the same wall temperature.

title: Copper mesh in paraffin (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: The conductive copper mesh insert shortened melting time relative to plain paraffin. Because the insert displaced wax, the enclosure stored less latent heat per unit volume.

title: Wall contact in a copper mesh enclosure (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: A conductive copper mesh insert in paraffin phase change material produced no measurable change in melting time when thermal contact between the mesh and heated wall was poor.

title: Aluminium fin spacing for a wax storage cell (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: Closely spaced aluminium fins conducted heat into the phase change material and accelerated melting. The widest fin spacing left pockets of solid wax near the corners after the same charging time.

title: Expanded graphite composites for thermal storage (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: Expanded graphite increased the effective thermal conductivity of the paraffin composite. Raising the graphite fraction reduced latent heat per kilogram of composite because the graphite did not undergo a phase change.

title: Cycling a hydrated salt storage cell (synthetic)
source_terms: Synthetic fixture created for PaperTrail. No external source.
text: Repeated melting and solidification caused salt crystals to settle at the base of the phase change material container. The segregated salt reduced the amount of heat released during later discharge cycles.
